title: About LeadTax
intro: Making tax filing simple, accessible, and stress-free for all Canadians.

mission.title: Our Mission
paragraphs: At LeadTax, we believe that filing your taxes shouldn't be complicated or expensive. We're dedicated to providing Canadian individuals, freelancers, and families with an easy-to-use, affordable tax solution that gives you confidence and peace of mind.

Whether you prefer to file online at your own pace, get expert help remotely, drop off your documents, or meet with a professional in person, we offer flexible options that fit your lifestyle and comfort level.
